about: Medians of 3 runs of 86Box fff297459 (upstream master, 2026-10-17, new recompiler) with the image in README.md. Only results that stayed within 3 % of their median over 4 runs are checked. The overall score is not: it is bimodal (about 1,645 or 1,842) because Game 2 runs at 15.3 or 18.7 FPS from run to run. The rasterizer score (18,776 to 20,998), fill rate and 2 MB texture speed vary too much as well.
